activities.name: Oyu (Ō-yu)
activities.notes: The largest and most iconic of Nozawa's 13 soto-yu. Edo-period samurai-style architecture; donation-funded. Tattoos accepted.

activities.name: Shinyu
activities.notes: Rebuilt 2006; known for its 'five-colour' water that visibly shifts hue with season and weather. Smaller, quieter than Oyu.

activities.name: Kuma-no-tearai-yu
activities.notes: Tiny bathhouse legendarily founded when a wounded bear was seen healing in the spring water. One of the hotter pools.

activities.name: Furusato-no-Yu
activities.notes: Modern community day-use bath with indoor and outdoor pools. The only onsen in Nozawa with showers, towels rental and a rest area.

activities.name: Ogama Hot Spring Source
activities.notes: Nozawa's 90°C natural hot-water source where villagers still cook eggs and onsen tamago. Cultural landmark, not for bathing.

activities.name: Kosuge Shrine (Fire Festival site)
activities.notes: Site of the Dosojin Fire Festival on 15 January, one of Japan's three great fire festivals. Worth visiting year-round for the wooden torii and quiet forest setting.
